user.title: Choose the EnOcean module
user.description: These modules answered on the serial ports of this system. Pick the one to use.

manual.title: Serial port of the EnOcean module
manual.description: Enter the serial port of the USB stick or of the built-in module, for example /dev/ttyUSB0. A path under /dev/serial/by-id/ keeps working when the system renumbers its USB ports.

reconfigure.title: Change the serial port
reconfigure.description: Use this after moving or replacing the USB stick. Adopted devices stay as they are. A new module has a different address: one-way actuators must then be paired again.

error.cannot_connect: No EnOcean module answered on this port. Check the port name, and that no other program or add-on is using it.

abort.already_configured: This EnOcean module is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: EnOcean Internal Chip is already set up. Only one module can be used.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The serial port has been changed.

data_description.auto_labels: New entities get a label such as Doors & windows, Climate or Buttons. Entities that already have labels are left alone.
data_description.role_labels: Doors and windows also get Perimeter, motion sensors Interior, smoke and CO alarms 24/7 safety.
data_description.notify_teach_in: Show a notification when a device that is not adopted yet sends a teach-in telegram.
data_description.allow_simulation: Lets the panel and the simulate action inject test telegrams. Turn it off when you are done testing.

options.teach_in_ute: Pairing request from a two-way switch (D2-01-12)

simulate.name: Simulate a telegram
simulate.description: Feeds a ready-made telegram to the integration as if a device had sent it. Needs the Allow simulated telegrams option.

sender.name: Sender ID
sender.description: The device ID the telegram comes from, like 05:00:00:01. Leave empty for the default ID of the telegram.

open_pairing.name: Open pairing
open_pairing.description: Lets two-way devices pair with the gateway for a while. Put the device into learn mode while pairing is open.

seconds.name: Duration
seconds.description: How long pairing stays open, from 10 to 600 seconds. 180 seconds if left empty.
